_doc: regression_due.py's map (LESSONS PR-2): each AI-player suite -> the NAMES of its evidence files in evidence_dir (case-insensitive globs) and the repo files it COVERS (case-sensitive globs; each must match a real file, and every module ai_player/ imports from this repo must be covered by every suite, or the tool exits 2). Initial map 2026-10-21 from the evidence names then on disk (step52 / step52reg / kb1-merge-units). COVERS were MEASURED 2026-10-21 (fix round): an import scan of ai_player/ resolves `modules` to sandbox-pokebot/modules/ (24 files import it), `scoring` to ai-agent/scoring.py (test_eyes, live_step1) and `mgba` to sandbox-pokebot/mgba/ (ignored by git: environment); the import closure of each suite's driver reaches brain/, host/ and those imports (revert_safety_gates runs test_safety_gates.py, which reaches 77 ai_player files, so it covers all of ai_player/, not only gates/); live_step5 runs the framework itself (launcher -> sandbox-pokebot/pokebot.py) and rate_step5 runs it in-process (play_harness), so both cover sandbox-pokebot/**. `exclude` mirrors provenance.EXCLUDED: evidence, Markdown and the seed ledger are not code under test. `environment`: what git ignores but a run depends on (the emulator binding the installer downloads, the bot's profiles, backups, logs, caches): regression_due cannot see it change and prints it as a NOTE on every run.
